decisions.reason: The passenger check-in app is a software option that costs little to maintain, and its value is still unresolved because the COVID aviation collapse hid its true prospects while recovery and demand for touchless processing could raise its worth.

PassBoard was a flagship launch building on core passenger-processing know-how, and with airport traffic only recovering in 2022 there is not yet enough evidence to justify abandoning this cheap-to-hold option.

Self-service check-in fits the post-pandemic push for contactless, cost-saving airport solutions, so the option stays open until recovering traffic shows whether airlines adopt it, although overlap with the other two products raises some risk of consolidation.
